questions.query: What financial penalty applies to a customer who operates without a valid Fitness Inspection and Fitness Certificate?
relevant: A Customer will be liable to appropriate financial penalty on per day basis so long as the offence continues.

questions.query: What conditions must a customer satisfy to renew an Innovation License?
relevant: 7.3. A Licence is valid for at least one year and is renewable, provided that: (a) the Customer holds a valid Fitness Certificate for its Premises (except where the Premises are offices and workstations provided by Jafza); (b) the Customer commits to submit its balance sheet (financial report) by the end of every financial year, audited by an auditor who is approved by Jafza.

questions.query: Which department oversees Environment, Health and Safety matters under Trakhees PCFC?
relevant: EHS the department of Environment, Health and Safety under Trakhees PCFC.

questions.query: What must customers do before receiving approval to dispose of liquid industrial waste?
relevant: However, as a policy, the Customer shall explore all possibilities to recycle/re-use and recover waste to the satisfaction of Jafza/EHS, prior to an approval for disposal of the same.

questions.query: What is the requirement for customers regarding employment agreements with their employees under Jafza rules?
relevant: A Customer shall execute an Employment Agreement with every Employee that it employs.

questions.query: Under Jafza's workforce protection programme, how is the required guarantee amount for a sponsored employee calculated?
relevant: The guarantee shall be equal to or higher than one and half month’s basic salary plus a one way Air Fare from Dubai to the Employee’s home country. The applicable Air Fare figure can be provided by Jafza for the purpose of this calculation.

questions.query: What must a customer do to use Jafza's sponsorship facility?
relevant: A Customer wishing to take advantage of this sponsorship facility will be required to sign a PSA with Jafza and to have a CIC ( Computer Immigration Card ) to be able to apply for visas.

questions.query: How many days does a customer have to make leased office space operational in Jafza unless an extension is granted in writing?
relevant: A Customer who Leases Premises from Jafza should ensure that the Premises are operational within the time stipulated below, unless Jafza extends the same in writing: (a) 60 days for office space;

questions.query: Is cooking permitted in every room of Jafza staff accommodation?
relevant: Cooking in the rooms of the Accommodation (other than the senior blocks/executive rooms, where kitchens are provided), is prohibited on the grounds of health and safety.

questions.query: Is photography inside the Jafza Free Zone permitted without official permission?
relevant: Photography inside the Free Z one, inc luding drone activities, is prohibited unless duly permitted in accordance with the applicable laws and legislations.

questions.query: What happens if a customer fails to comply with a Prohibition Notice, Correction Notice, or Warning Notice?
relevant: Failure to comply with a Prohibition Notice, Correction Notice or Warning Notice may result in a penalty and fine.

questions.query: What penalty applies to an Accommodation occupant who violates Free Zone Rules by storing goods or alcohol?
relevant: If an occupant of an Accommodation is found to be in violation of these Free Zone Rules with respect to the use of the Accommodation , such as storin g goods, storing alco hol or conducting unauthorised activities, such occupant will be subject to fine on each occasion and may suffer potential legal action.

questions.query: What documentation must a Customer possess to operate in the Free Zone?
relevant: A Customer shall have a valid Lease and a valid Licence to operate in the Free Zone.

questions.query: What is the postal address and phone number of the Free Zone customs?
relevant: The postal address and phone number of the Free Zone customs is: P.O. Box 17017 Dubai, United Arab Emirates Tel: 9714-8055232/233 Fax: 9714-8811314

questions.query: If parties request it, what action does Jafza take when no resolution is reached?
relevant: Where a resolution is not reached Jafza shall transfer the matter to the Dubai Courts (by any means adopted in the Free Zone w ith the Courts including the Virtual Reality Smart Court) if it is requested by one of the parties.

questions.query: What type of company is an FZE?
relevant: FZE a free zone establishment, which is a limited liability company with one shareholder, incorporated in accordance with the regulations promulgated by Jafza.

questions.query: What is the telephone number for reporting traffic accidents or incidents in the Jafza Free Zone?
relevant: Traffic accidents, incidents or violations shall be reported to the relevant security department control room. The relevant security department telephone number is: 800 379 222 / 048832200.

questions.query: What is the rule regarding cooking in the Premises?
relevant: Cooking is not permitted in the Premises.

questions.query: What is the required third party liability insurance amount for up to 19 employees?
relevant: The value of insurance cover required for third party liability is AE D 500,000 for up to 19 Employees and AED 1, 000,000 for 20 Employees or above.

questions.query: What is the maximum duration allowed for a container or portacabin to be used in the Free Zone?
relevant: If approved, a refundable deposit, as per relevant EHS procedure, shall be payable for each container or portacabin and a time frame for use of container or portacabin will be agreed, which shall be no greater than four months.

questions.query: What penalties can a Jafza customer face for breaching premises rules about stored materials, waste, or unauthorized activities?
relevant: To en sure compliance , Premises will be thoroughly checked by inspectors in different categories as m entioned below , and a breach by the Customer may result in a warning, financial penalty , termination of License or any other penalty determined by Jafz a.

questions.query: What penalty does EHS-Trakhees apply if a customer fails to immediately report an accident, including a minor one, to the PCFC emergency control room?
relevant: In the ev ent of failing to immediately report an accident, including a minor one, to PCFC emergency control room on telephone 8833111, EHS-Trakhees shall levy a fine as per EHS penalty code.

questions.query: What is the penalty for selling pirated media in Jafza?
relevant: Those found selling pirated media will be penalized and the stock of the same will be confiscated;

questions.query: What insurance responsibility does a customer have for premises they have erected?
relevant: For Premises erected by a Customer, the Customer shall be responsible for arranging the insurance, which shall be in the joint names of the Customer and Jafza.

questions.query: What is the time limit for imposing the penalty after the disciplinary finding?
relevant: The penalty may not be imposed after the lapse of 60 days from the date of th e disciplinary finding.

questions.query: When may Jafza disconnect electricity supply to the Premises?
relevant: Jafza reserves the right to disconnect electricity supply to the Premises in the event that any accounts payable to Jafza or to Dubai Electricity and Water Authority are not paid within the prescribed period.

questions.query: Under the Jafza Free Zone Rules, what circumstances cause an employee to lose entitlement to compensation for an industrial accident?
relevant: An Employee shall not be entitled to compensation (be it medical treatment or pay ment of salary) in accordance w ith th ese Free Zone R ules if enquiries by the competent authority establish t hat the Employee caused the accident through: (a) willful neglect; (b) intentional violation of environment, health and/or safety regulations; (c) being under the influence of illicit drugs or alcohol; (d) deliberate misconduct; (e) self-harm; or (f) unreasonably refusing medical treatment/check-up as prescribed by a medical board set up to assess the ability to return to work/disability.

questions.query: What is the overtime pay rate for hours worked between 10:00 pm and 4:00 am?
relevant: Overtime shall be paid at the rate of 125% of the basic hourly rate, whereas overtime worked between the hours of 10:00 pm and 4:00 am shall be paid at the rate of 150% of the basic hourly rate, and overtime worked on Public H olidays or on the weekly rest day shall be paid at the normal hourly rate in addition to 50% of the basic hourly rate.

questions.query: Are containers allowed for storage on a Customer’s Premises?
relevant: Use of containers for any kind of storage is not permitted; this includes containers used for material storage within the warehouse, light industrial unit, showroom as well as outdoors.

questions.query: What document must the Customer provide to an Employee when the Employee's service ends?
relevant: 11.8.17 The Employee, on termination of service may request, and the Customer shall provide, free of charge a “Service Certificate” to show: (a) period of service; (b) designation and/or title and work performed; and 11.9. final rate of pay and bonus, if any and if applicable.

questions.query: Which entity is responsible for heavy industrial solid waste disposal, and to which authority must the disposal requirement be submitted for initial approval during project planning?
relevant: Disposal of heavy industrial solid waste shall be the responsibility of companies generating such waste. However, the requirement for d isposal of such waste should be intimat ed to Jafza/EHS- Trakhees at the project planning/application stage itself for initial approval from Dubai Municipality.

questions.query: Where can the Free Zone Rules be accessed in electronic format?
relevant: These Free Zone Rules are also available in electronic format on the Free Zone website: www.jafza.ae

questions.query: When does an employee lose their gratuity entitlement?
relevant: Entitlement to gratuity shall be forfeited if the Employee resigns before completing one year of service.

questions.query: What is the fee for a new or renewed JAFZA trading license that covers one group of up to seven activities?
relevant: Trading License - New or Renewal or Amendment ( One Group – up to 7 activities) 5,000

questions.query: What penalties can a customer face for failing to register with the WPS as required by Jafza?
relevant: A Customer failing to register with the WPS, as required by Jafza, may suffer penalties in accordance with Article 14.3.3 of these Rules.

questions.query: What is the consequence for a Customer who fails to notify Jafza about an absconding employee within seven days?
relevant: 14.3.4 A Customer who fails to notify Jafza about an absconding Employee within seven (7) may be subject to fines and penalties.

questions.query: Who is required to approve the sub‑Lease agreement?
relevant: The sub-Lease agreement shall be approved by Jafza.

questions.query: Who is allowed to inspect customer premises in Jafza?
relevant: A Customer should no te that inspections shall on ly be carried out by local and federal authorities, Jafza or any other authorities specifically authorised to inspect by Jafza. Inspection by any other 20 person or organisation is strictly prohibited, unless prior approval of Jafza is obtained.

questions.query: What conditions allow Jafza to waive a rule for a customer?
relevant: Jafza may waive a Rule contained in these Free Zone Rules , for one or more than one Customer, subject to terms and conditions that Jafza may prescribe.

questions.query: How should non-hazardous industrial solid waste be managed under Dubai Municipality requirements?
relevant: However, such industrial w astes shall be collected, stored, and/or disposed separately as per Dubai Municipality requirements.

questions.query: Who is responsible for handing over passports to sponsored employees under Jafza regulations?
relevant: It is the responsibility of the Customer to hand over the employees' passports to each Sponsored Employee.

questions.query: What is the term used for a Customer leasing Premises in the Free Zone?
relevant: A Customer leasing Premises shall be referred to as a “Lessee” and the grantor of a Lease shall be referred to as a “Lessor”.

questions.query: What fine does Jafza impose for a first-time violation of the rule against cooking food in accommodation rooms?
relevant: A v iolator of this rule shall be warned through the Customer on the first occasion and subject to a fine of AED 5,000 .

questions.query: What is the consequence for a customer who hinders an inspection by Jafza?
relevant: A Customer shall not in any way restrict or hinder the entrance or inspection by a State, local or federal authority, by Jafza or by any other representative specifically authorised to inspect by Jafza, failing which the Customer shall be liable to a fine.

questions.query: What marking is required for products exported from the Jebel Ali Free Zone to the United States?
relevant: A Customer exporting either manufactured or labeled products from the Fre e Zone to the United States is required to mark as “Made in JEBEL ALI FREE ZONE, Dubai”.

questions.query: Which entity can perform inspections across any part of the Free Zone?
relevant: Jafza may directly or through an authorized person or body carry out inspection in any area of the Free Zone.

questions.query: Within how many days must a Customer submit a written report to the EHS following an accident?
relevant: Within one day of an accident, a Customer must present a written report to th e EHS and in accordance with the EHS procedures, provide the Employee’s name, identity number, job title, address and nat ionality.

questions.query: What are the consequences for a Customer who fails to satisfy Jafza?
relevant: Failing to do so to the satisfaction of Jafza, the Customer will be considered in violation to the Rules.

questions.query: What is issued to a sponsored employee in Jafza?
relevant: A Sponsored Employee will be issued a Company Employment Card (“CEC”), which provides a unique identification.

questions.query: What is the fine per person if an unauthorized individual is found staying in a customer's Jafza accommodation?
relevant: In c ase of violation a fine (per person) of AED 10,000 to be imposed.

questions.query: What is required for the disposal of waste material or contaminated soil?
relevant: 19.4 dispose waste material or contaminated soil in accordance with Free Zone regulations, for which approval from EHS should be obtained.

questions.query: What penalty might a driver face for parking a vehicle in an area that is not an approved public parking zone or the leased area?
relevant: 31 Vehicles shall only be parked in designated public parking or in the Leased area; violators may incur fines.

questions.query: What must a customer do with access passes when an employee's employment ends?
relevant: In the case of ceasing employment, the Customer must ensure that all passes issued to its Employees are returned to Jafza.

questions.query: What approval is needed for a sponsored employee to work temporarily outside the Jafza Free Zone?
relevant: However there may be occasions when a Customer requires a Sponsored Employee to work temporarily outside the Free Zone on a temporary basis (e.g. installation, repair, or maintenance of specialist equipment) in which case Jafza’s prior approval is required.

questions.query: What authorities must approve a Jafza customer's premises modifications?
relevant: Whether a Customer builds on a Plot, modifies a Ready Built Premises , o r obta ins a Ready Built Premises in as -is-condition, the Premises allocation and modification has to be approved by Jafza and Trakhees (CED/EHS /fire departments) and the Customer shall ensure that a ll rules, regulations, requirements, standards, guideli nes and procedures of Jafza and of relevant authorities are adhered to, including those of CED/EHS and fire department, during the construction , installation or operational stage.

questions.query: How are roads within the Free Zone legally treated?
relevant: The roads in the Free Zone are treated as public roads.

questions.query: What is the cap on compensation that a customer owes for illegally dismissing an employee who filed a proven court claim or serious complaint?
relevant: 11.8.8 The amount of compensation payable under Rule 11.8.7 above: (a) shall be verified by Jafza in accordance with the UAE Labour Law; and (b) shall not exceed three times the total monthly salary (inclusive of allowances).

questions.query: What fine does Jafza impose on a customer who bars its inspectors from entering the premises for the first time?
relevant: A Customer barring Jafza’s inspectors from entering the Premises or hindering their tasks in any way is, in addition to any penalty or actio n, liable for a fine of AED 5,000/- on the first occasion. The fine will be AED 10,000/- on any subsequent occasion.
